about_the_game:
The Story

You play as Alice, an 18-year-old whose summer vacation takes an unexpected turn: when she discovers the old notebook of her late grandfather, she stumbles upon tales of an incredible journey — of an alchemist who can turn everything into gold, and of a path leading out of the dull village of Süßsponn into a world full of dangers, wonders, and temptations.

On your journey, you’ll explore four hand-crafted pixel worlds — each shaped by its own unique atmosphere. You’ll fight, combine, solve puzzles, and make choices that mean more than they first appear. What is the truth behind Grandpa’s mysterious book? And who can you really trust here? Does morality always require an authority — and is there such a thing as one truth?

Join Alice on an adventure about morality, power — and the question of whether values can endure without truth.

Gameplay

  • Solve puzzles by combining items with each other and with the world around you

  • Learn new abilities and use them wisely in battles against cute candy creatures

  • Talk to strange, endearing, and threatening characters to uncover more about your grandfather — and about yourself

  • Explore four imaginative worlds: Cotton Candy, Licorice, Gummy, and Cookie — each with its own dangers and rules

  • Discover the meaning of morality, values, and truth

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: 10 / 11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: INTEL Core i3 2.4GHz
  • Memory: 4 MB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce GT 830 / RADEON R7 340
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: Fully playable with keyboard only. Some navigation on the game page does not work well.

Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: 10 / 11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: INTEL Core i5 2.00GHz
  • Memory: 4 MB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce GTX 850 / RADEON R7 360X
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: Fully playable with keyboard only. Some navigation on the game page does not work well.
